Job Description 
 
 About FIS 
 
 Are you curious, motivated, and forward-thinking? At FIS you’ll have the opportunity to work on some of the most challenging and relevant issues in financial services and technology. Our talented people empower us, and we believe in being part of a team that is open, collaborative, entrepreneurial, passionate and above all fun. 
 
 Current and future sponsorship are not available for this position  
 
 This role is hybrid for Jacksonville, Atlanta, & Milwaukee Only 

   

 About the team  

   

 You would be joining a tea m   that is a   dynamic combination of internal and external members who work together through strong client engagement and collaboration. By   bringing   together diverse e xpertise   and perspectives, the team   delivers   a c utting-edge   product designed to meet the evolving needs of our clients and   their   customers.    

   

 What you will be doing  
 

 As a Mainframe Software Engineer, you will contribute to the development, enhancement, and support of critical card management and payment processing solutions. You will design, develop, test, and   maintain   mainframe applications that support transaction processing, reconciliation, settlement, compliance, and modernization initiatives. 
 
 Success in this role requires   collaboration with cross-functional teams, and a commitment to delivering high-quality, secure, and reliable solutions. You will play a key role in regulatory compliance, product enhancements, production support, and continuous improvement efforts.   
 

 Develop, enhance, and   maintain   mainframe applications using COBOL and related technologies.   

 
 Design and execute comprehensive unit tests to   validate   application functionality and performance.   

 
 Collaborate with business, product, quality assurance, and engineering teams throughout the development lifecycle.   

 
 Conduct peer code reviews and contribute to continuous improvement of development standards.   

 
 Participate in technical design discussions, code walkthroughs, and solution reviews.   

 
 Create and maintain technical documentation, test evidence, and change records to support audit and compliance requirements.   

 
   

 What you bring 
 


 COBOL Programming Fundamentals .  (1 - 3 years experience) 

 
 IBM z/OS Mainframe Knowledge.   

 
 Foundational knowledge   with IMS DB/DC, CICS, VSAM, IMS, DB2, and MQ Series.   

 
 Knowledge of software development lifecycle practices, testing methodologies, and change management processes.   

 
 Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving capabilities.   

 
 Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to work effectively across teams.   

 
   

 Bonus if you have 
 

 Knowledge of Agile or Scrum delivery methodologies.   

 
 Experience within card payments, debit processing, or financial services domains.   

 
 Exposure to payment processing, transaction management, reconciliation, or settlement systems.   

 
 Familiarity with modernization initiatives, API integration, and legacy system transformation.   

 
 Experience supporting compliance, security remediation, and vulnerability management programs.   

 
   

 What we offer you  

   

 Attractive benefits including private medical cover, dental cover, and travel insurance.   

 
 A variety of career development tools, resources and opportunities.   

 

 The chance to work on some of the most challenging, relevant issues in financial services & technology.   

 
 Great   workspaces   with dedicated and motivated colleagues.   

 
 A work environment built on collaboration, flexibility and respect. 

 

 

 
 Privacy Statement 
 
 FIS is committed to protecting the privacy and security of all personal information that we process in order to provide services to our clients. For specific information on how FIS protects personal information online, please see the Online Privacy Notice .
 
 EEOC Statement 
 
 FIS is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, genetic information, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.  For positions located in the US, the following conditions apply. If you are made a conditional offer of employment, you will be required to undergo a drug test. ADA Disclaimer: In developing this job description care was taken to include all competencies needed to successfully perform in this position. However, for Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) purposes, the essential functions of the job may or may not have been described for purposes of ADA reasonable accommodation.  Sourcing Model 
 
 Recruitment at FIS works primarily on a direct sourcing model; a relatively small portion of our hiring is through recruitment agencies. FIS does not accept resumes from recruitment agencies which are not on the preferred supplier list and is not responsible for any related fees for resumes submitted to job postings, our employees, or any other part of our company.
